sites.notes: Shopify public app (Tree Contribution widget) + Heroku admin dashboard. The test store is storefront-password protected.

performance.reason: No scored storefront pages for this project.

security.note: Unauthenticated login page of the admin dashboard only.

dns.reason: Dashboard is on a shared herokuapp.com domain; DNS findings would not be actionable.

seo.reason: Admin dashboard is not a public site.

ai-crawlers.reason: Admin dashboard is not a public site.

network.note: Availability + response time (UptimeRobot when UPTIMEROBOT_API_KEY is set, live probe otherwise).

functional.reason: Shopify widget capture (Product page / cart drawer / cart page, 8 device sizes) needs the storefront password and has no runner in the repo yet (see docs/LIMITATIONS.md).

companion-app.note: Read-only dashboard QA (83+ checks); every non-GET request is aborted in the browser and reported critical.

cache.reason: Server/build-cache metrics are captured manually from the hosting dashboard; no API runner exists yet.

secrets.purpose: Admin dashboard login (use a dedicated read-only monitoring user)
Shopify storefront password for the widget capture (not used by any runner yet)

optional: config/monthly-monitoring-input-<month>.json for the client deck (theme update log, widget screenshot links, dev-team notes)
inputs.notes: There is no scored storefront. Do NOT ask for PageSpeed Before/After scores for this project.

context: Shopify public app (Tree Contribution widget) plus a Heroku admin dashboard. The monthly audit is the read-only dashboard QA, security checks of the dashboard login page, and the widget audit on the Horizon theme. No PageSpeed scores are used. The test store is storefront-password protected, so the widget capture cannot run unattended.
